description: Create a new prediction market on FlipCoin. Requires title, resolution criteria, and resolution source URL. Optionally set category, liquidity tier, initial price. Requires auto_sign delegation for autonomous operation.

auto_sign.description: Auto-sign with session key (Mode B). Requires delegation setup.

category.description: Market category (crypto, politics, sports, tech, etc.)

initialPriceYesBps.description: Initial YES price in basis points (100-9900, default 5000 = 50%)

resolutionDate.description: ISO 8601 date when outcome can be determined

resolutionSource.description: HTTPS URL of authoritative data source for resolution

title.description: Market question (e.g. 'Will BTC reach $100k by end of 2025?'). Maps to the canonical 'question' field in the API.

name: create_market
